research.title: How modern payments drive growth and resilience
research.summary: Payments decisions now influence growth, liquidity, and risk — often as much as traditional finance levers. In this episode of Making Sense, co-heads of J.P. Morgan Global Payments Max Neukirchen and Umar Farooq explain how payments became a revenue-enabling capability — and what “trust at scale” requires when clients expect instant, seamless experiences. They cover the move toward real-time rails, the operational demands of always-on infrastructure and the new fraud landscape where threats accelerate with speed. They also detail how data and AI-driven controls help safeguard transactions without adding friction.
